title: Chapter 528 - 528 Hot-Blooded; Time Restaurant!
content:
Chapter 528 - 528 Hot-Blooded; Time Restaurant!

Chapter 528 - 528 Hot-Blooded; Time Restaurant!

528 Hot-Blooded; Time Restaurant!

The comments under Nation Daily’s posts increased rapidly.

1,000!

10,000!

100,000!

1996 After Dusk: [Nobel Prize in physics, Nobel Prize in chemistry, Nobel Prize in medicine, and Nobel Peace Prize! Professor Lin Fan has won four Nobel Prizes! Professor Lin, you’re the greatest!]

Gu Gu: [The Emperor of Mathematics, the creator of the chip, the guardian of Earth, the guardian of humanity, the angel who saves the dying and heals the wounded, the elite of peace! After hearing the Nation Daily’s evaluation, for some reason, my eyes suddenly moistened!]

Worldly Trails: [I’m inexplicably excited!]

Freedom Like the Wind: [If I remember correctly, this is the first time that the Nation Daily has published so many Weibo posts about one person in a row, right?]

Hello Tomorrow: [I thought that the Nation Daily had mistaken Weibo for Moments.]

No One Loves You if You’re Not Stupid: [Either you don’t win the Nobel Prize, or you win four!]

Qian Renxue: [Professor Lin, awesome!]

Why Not: [Professor Lin is awesome!]

Fallen Decease: [Professor Lin, awesome!]

…

Lin Fan did not care about the news published by the Nation Daily.

He did not care, but many were so excited that they could not control themselves.

…

Jiangbei University, the chancellor’s office.

Principal Shen Liang looked at the news on Weibo and shouted excitedly, “Good, good, good! That’s great!”

He picked up his phone and was about to call Lin Fan.

However, he quickly put it down and muttered, “No, I have to congratulate him in person!”

As he spoke, he took skipped toward Lin Fan’s office.

That appearance…

He was like a child who had just received a certificate. He was extremely happy.

It was normal for Shen Liang to be like this.

He was an educational worker and a Chinese scholar.

It was the most regrettable thing that there was no Chinese Nobel Prize winner in the field of science.

Now, this hope had finally been fulfilled!

Moreover, Lin Fan won the Nobel Prize in medicine, chemistry, and physics at once.

More importantly, this person… was from Jiangbei University!

When Shen Liang arrived at the office, the dean of the Mathematics Department, the dean of the Chemistry Department, the dean of the Medical Department, the dean of the Physics Department, and many other professors had already arrived.

However, in the office, there were only Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the other students. Where was Lin Fan?

“Professor Lin said that he has something to deal with during this period of time, so he might not come to school for the next few days…” Hao Zhiwu said.

Shen Liang, the deans, and the other professors looked at each other helplessly.

It seemed like… they could not congratulate him in person.

However, this helplessness came and went quickly.

After a while, their faces were filled with excitement again.

“Our Chemistry Department is preparing to hold a large-scale report on super batteries…”

“Our Physics Department is preparing for a seminar on earthquake prediction devices…”

…

Shen Liang listened to everyone’s words and nodded repeatedly, “Everyone, work hard together. We must do a good job of promoting Professor Lin Fan. This… This will be the highest priority of Jiangbei University.”

“Yes, Sir!” everyone said in unison.

…

When Lin Fan saw that he had won the Nobel Prize, the reactions of Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, and the others, as well as the heated discussions on the internet, made Lin Fan realize that things were going to be very troublesome.

Lin Fan hated trouble.

Thus, he left Jiangbei University and took a few days off.

At this moment, Lin Fan had already arrived at the Coiling Dragon Villa.

He lay on the soft sofa, swiping his phone while eating the exquisite desserts sent by the two-star Michelin restaurant. He was extremely satisfied.

In the blink of an eye, it was the second day.

The heavy rain last night made the morning air heavy with a sweet smell.

The little caterpillars hiding in the tree holes could not help but crawl out to breathe in the sweet air.

While the caterpillars were intoxicated, a ferocious and terrifying giant bird suddenly flew over from afar. It used its terrifying beak to peck down fiercely and directly ate the caterpillars.

“I ate another bug!”

“I also ate a total of bugs!” said a little bird beside it.

“Let’s continue!”

Amidst the chirping of the little bird, Lin Fan slowly opened his eyes.

Out of habit, he glanced at his phone. A message had already appeared on the screen.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 36,790,010 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to the sign-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! You’ve successfully signed in. Congratulations, you’ve obtained the Time Restaurant.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s expression changed. “Finally, it’s not 10 million.”

“Time Restaurant? A while ago, I heard Hao Zhiwu say that it’s a restaurant with good food…”

At this moment, Lin Fan’s stomach growled.

“I don’t have anything to do anyway. I’ll go to Time Restaurant for a meal later. I can also check in on my own restaurant.”

After saying that, Lin Fan slowly crawled up.

After washing up, he picked up the keys to the Cullinan and walked out.

He stepped on the gas pedal, and the V12 engine roared like a beast as it sped off into the distance.

The security guards standing at the door stood up straight like soldiers being inspected.

At this time, it was already past the peak of the morning rush, and every road was relatively empty.

About half an hour later, Lin Fan arrived at Time Restaurant.

The restaurant had a total of three floors and occupied a large area. The decorations were very warm and comfortable, giving people the feeling of returning home.

A round-faced woman about 1.55 meters tall was holding a phone as she walked to the entrance of the Time Restaurant.

“Good morning, everyone!” she said into her phone. “Recently, I’ve heard a lot of people recommending Time Restaurant in Jiangbei. Today, I’ll try it on behalf of everyone!

“Let’s see if the food here is as delicious as everyone has said!”

The round-faced woman’s name was Li Haiyan, and she was a food streamer with three million fans.

Li Haiyan explored restaurants and showed off her good looks.

Generally speaking, a round-faced woman who was 1.55 meters tall was not as good-looking.

However, her appearance in the live broadcast had strangely changed. She had an oval face, big eyes, and fair skin. Overall, she looked like a beauty who had walked out of a comic.

This… This was the magical part of Douyin. It had the magical ability to completely change a person’s appearance.

Then, Li Haiyan turned the camera to the entrance of Time Restaurant.
